title: Core is published one way, forkable under Apache-2.0: align mandates and docs, remove duplicates
goal: Vision: V-4. Record the CEO directive of 2026-11-16 that intellibitz/susi is Apache-2.0 and published one way (push authority is the CEO's alone; the world may fork and work in its fork), make every governance and contribution document say so, remove the invitations to send pull requests, fix stale pillar counts and mandate ranges, drop duplicated banners and summaries, and guard the statement with a governance test.

reuse.searched: Both repositories' governance documents (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, README.md, VISION.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CONTRIBUTORS.md, docs/ceo-agent-mandate.md, docs/ceo-mandate-74..81.md, docs/lean-core.md, .agents/identity.json) and the existing governance drift guards (tests/architecture_tests.rs, tests/three_pillars_governance.rs, tests/agent_bootstrap.rs). The directive amends existing Mandate 72 and the open-core boundary instead of adding a new mandate document, and its guard is one more test beside the existing mandate guards. No new code path, dependency or harvest.

limitations: Documentation, the constitution text of Mandate 72 and governance tests only; no runtime behaviour changes. Main is unqualified development, not a release.

The Susi Board was read at session start (1550 items, no stop note, no open claim on these paths) but could not be written from this cloud session: its storage credentials refuse refs/board/* and refs/claims/* with HTTP 403. No Claim or Landed item was posted; coordination is through this record and the commit trailers (Mandate 76 section 7).
crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs BRIEF still describes Mandates 43-74 and was not changed.
Push authority is recorded as the CEO's alone, exercised by the CEO or by the agents the CEO authorizes; that reading of the directive follows Mandates 62 and 73 and is the CEO's to correct.
